primary_review.finding: Firsthand university-hosted Scottie B account names Bmore Club Music as Baltimore house/hip-hop synthesis and identifies Unruly history. This positively establishes the same named practice, rather than inferring equivalence from shared performers.

Reviewed all100 exposed playlist positions. Core includes RodLee,KWGriff,DJClass,KSwift,Technics,ScottieB,MissTony and explicitly named Baltimore/Bmore club remixes. The roster also includes Jersey/Philadelphia and wider crossover contributors, remixers and apparent peripheral selections; not every track is asserted canonical Baltimore club. Those discovery-list edges provide no independently documented alternative Bmore tradition.

equivalences.actual_existing_scope: Existing baltimore_club explicitly covers early1990s Baltimore sampled house/breakbeat practice, RodLee/KSwift/DJClass/Unruly and crossover exemplars. Source terminology matches that musical lineage and community. The existing row is not restricted to a single artist or historical recording.
equivalences.decision: Treat Bmore as an alias of existing Baltimore club. Do not integrate an additional row or alter old instrumentation. Playlist overlap supports contextual consistency but is not the equivalence proof; firsthand same-practice naming is decisive.
equivalences.limitations: Full exposed100 playlist positions checked, not an assertion of exhaustive all-time repertoire identity or a classification of every peripheral track.

tradition.name: Big room house (EDM festival)
tradition.lineage: Early-2010s house subgenre engineered for large festival main-stage performance contexts. Characterized by enormous-build-up-and-drop song-structure, simplified melodic and harmonic content, massive distorted-synth festival-anthem peak-sections, and predictable formulaic arrangement. Hardwell, Martin Garrix, Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike, and the Spinnin' Records-Revealed Recordings label rosters define the canonical sound. Tomorrowland, Ultra Music Festival, and EDC Las Vegas constitute the canonical festival circuit.
